claim.statement: OpenAI's 0.90.0 release notes say collaboration mode shipped as a beta in the terminal UI with Coding and Plan selections and a plan-to-execute handoff.

source.title: OpenAI Codex release 0.90.0
source.locator: New Features — collaboration mode beta, plan-to-execute handoff and Coding versus Plan (#9690, #9712, #9802, #9834)

limitations: The release calls collaboration mode beta; the catalog did not observe either mode or the handoff.
The release note does not fully enumerate mode-specific prompts, tools, authority or transition behavior.
unknowns: The selected mode and whether a session transitions from Plan to Coding are unknown.
Mode-specific model, prompt, tool, approval and persistence differences are unknown.
